original execution receipt binds exact retained v52 comparison bytes
original v52 receipt binds exact original v50 baseline raw bytes
original v52 receipt binds exact supplied v52 replay raw bytes

relation: The declared v52 comparator projection of the exact v52 replay equals the common original v50 projection; the declared projection of the exact frozen v53 replay equals that same original projection. Equality is therefore transitive for every retained field in that unchanged declared projection.

materialProjection.qualification: All three own material layers are reconstructed independently from the complete recorded event journal at every acquired prefix. Complete provider envelopes, point bindings, unknown-effect declarations, every acquired event, latest receipt, counts and all retained own state fields are compared, including restored negative zero. Session-dependent IDs are related only through the retained independently checked source/native recipes; both native recipe hashes and proposal IDs are recomputed. The four common-caller wrapper fields composition_target_tree, field_subquestion, morphology and strategy_receipt are outside this own-layer projection. Existing caller selection/coordination checks remain separate; no full inherited state or graph-chain equality is asserted.

limits: No assertion is removed, replaced, skipped or weakened. Full graph-chain/implementation identity and fields already excluded by the unchanged comparator remain outside the claim. No new live success or speed result is implied. The earlier wrong-baseline executions remain failed receipts.

wrongBaselineDiagnosis.cause: The existing material recipe adapter rebases only its beforeScope. It requires the original v50 baseline. Supplying the already-rebased v52 replay fails to rebase recipe scopes and identities. SIGKILL is observed; resource-exhaustion cause is not independently established.
